title: Bridgette Wrona and the Whisper Creek Murders
original_title: Bridgette Wrona and the Whisper Creek Murders
overview: 20-something sleuth Bridgette Wrona is the hostess of a popular true crime podcast called ‘Hot Coffee, Cold Cases.’ For her latest case, Bridgette is dispatched to the remote East Texas town of Whisper Creek, where a long-dormant serial killer known as The Flower King has resurfaced. Haunted by memories from her own rural past, Bridgette must uncover the truth in a place where everyone is a suspect.
